_table: Service of notice: statutorily authorized methods
_note: method describes the permitted service sequence with the controlling citation inline.
_notice: General reference, not legal advice. Statutes change and vary by jurisdiction; verify every figure against the current official state code before relying on it. Last reviewed 2026-05.

AK.method: Alaska Stat. § 09.45.110: personal delivery; if not found, posting + first-class mail to last known address.

AL.method: Ala. Code § 35-9A-202(b): personal delivery, posting on premises with mailing, or first-class mail.

AR.method: Ark. Code § 18-17-901: written notice delivered personally or by mail; verify with local district court rules.

AZ.method: A.R.S. § 33-1313: personal delivery; or by posting in conspicuous place AND mailing certified mail.

CA.method: Cal. Civ. Proc. Code § 1162(a), THREE permitted methods: (1) personal delivery on tenant; (2) SUBSTITUTED: leave with person of suitable age + discretion at residence OR business AND mail copy to residence; (3) NAIL-AND-MAIL: only if (1) and (2) not feasible after attempts at BOTH residence and business, post conspicuously + mail. Certified mail alone is NOT equivalent to personal service. Leibovich v Shahrokhkhany (1997) 56 CA4th 511.

CO.method: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 13-40-108: personal service; if absent, posting on premises + mailing within 1 day. Three attempts at different times required.

CT.method: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 47a-23: service by state marshal or constable; ABODE service (leaving at usual place of abode) permitted.

DC.method: D.C. Code § 16-1502: service by U.S. marshal or court-designated process server; ABODE service permitted.

DE.method: Del. Code tit. 25 § 5113: personal delivery; if not available, posting on premises + first-class mail.

FL.method: Fla. Stat. § 83.56(4): mailing OR personal delivery to tenant. If tenant absent from premises, post in conspicuous place. Certified mail with return receipt strongly preferred.

GA.method: O.C.G.A. § 44-7-50: statute requires 'demand for possession'; method must comply with magistrate court rules (personal service by sheriff typical).

HI.method: Haw. Rev. Stat. § 521-68: written notice delivered personally or by certified mail; posting permitted if tenant cannot be found.

IA.method: Iowa Code § 562A.29A: personal delivery; certified mail with return receipt; OR posting + mailing if landlord made good-faith effort.

ID.method: Idaho Code § 6-304: personal service; if not feasible, leave with adult occupant + mail.

IL.method: 735 ILCS 5/9-211: personal delivery to tenant or person 13+ residing on premises; OR posting if no one in possession. Certified mail not authorized for predicate notice (use only for record).

IN.method: Ind. Code § 32-31-1-6: personal delivery; if not feasible, leave conspicuously at premises + first-class mail.

KS.method: Kan. Stat. § 58-2570: personal delivery or certified mail.

KY.method: KRS § 383.665: personal delivery or first-class mail. URLTA counties may require certified.

LA.method: La. Code Civ. Proc. art. 4702: written notice; can be by sheriff, by mail, or by hand delivery (parish rules vary).

MA.method: M.G.L. ch. 186 § 11: written notice; service by constable, sheriff, or any disinterested adult; sworn return of service required.

MD.method: Md. Code, Real Prop. § 8-401(b): service typically by sheriff or constable per the District Court rules; first-class mail permitted with proof.

ME.method: 14 M.R.S. § 6002(2): service by sheriff OR by another method permitted by Maine R. Civ. P.; mail receipt required.

MI.method: Mich. Comp. Laws § 600.5718: personal delivery; substituted service to person of suitable age at premises + first-class mail.

MN.method: Minn. Stat. § 504B.135: personal delivery OR by mail; landlord must keep proof of service.

MO.method: Mo. Rev. Stat. § 535.020: demand by personal delivery, leaving with adult at premises, OR posting and mailing.

MS.method: Miss. Code § 89-8-13: written notice may be by personal delivery, by certified mail, OR by email/text if tenant has agreed in writing.

MT.method: Mont. Code § 70-24-108: personal delivery; or by first-class mail; or, if unsuccessful, by posting in conspicuous place + mailing.

NC.method: N.C.G.S. § 42-29: service by sheriff. Posting + first-class mail permitted only after sheriff's two unsuccessful attempts.

ND.method: N.D.C.C. § 47-32-02: personal service; if not feasible, leaving with adult at premises + first-class mail.

NE.method: Neb. Rev. Stat. § 76-1414: personal delivery OR certified mail with return receipt.

NH.method: N.H. Rev. Stat. § 540:5: service by sheriff, constable, or any disinterested adult; sworn affidavit of service.

NJ.method: N.J.S.A. 2A:42-10.16: service in same manner as summons under N.J.R. 4:4 (personal, abode, or registered/certified mail per court rule).

NM.method: N.M.S.A. § 47-8-43: personal delivery; or by mail; or by posting on the door (with mailing) if other methods fail.

NV.method: Nev. Rev. Stat. § 40.280: personal delivery; or substituted service on adult at premises + mail; or posting + mail if no one available. Process server's affidavit required.

NY.method: NY RPAPL § 735: (1) personal delivery; (2) substituted service: leave with adult of suitable age + mail BOTH certified AND regular mail within 1 business day; (3) CONSPICUOUS-PLACE ('nail and mail') AFTER TWO DILIGENT ATTEMPTS at different times (one outside business hours) + mail certified and regular mail. Process server affidavit required.

OH.method: Ohio Rev. Code § 1923.04(A): (1) certified mail with return receipt; (2) personal delivery; (3) leaving at usual place of abode of defendant.

OK.method: Okla. Stat. tit. 41 § 132: personal delivery; substituted service per court rule.

OR.method: ORS 90.155: (1) personal delivery; (2) first-class mail (add 3 days to notice period); (3) NAIL-AND-MAIL on the main entrance + first-class mail.

PA.method: 68 P.S. § 250.501(b): service by personal delivery or by leaving on the premises with a person residing there, age 18+. Posting permitted if no one available.

RI.method: R.I. Gen. Laws § 34-18-56: personal delivery OR first-class mail with certificate of mailing.

SC.method: S.C. Code § 27-37-20: service by magistrate or constable; or by registered or certified mail; or posting + mail.

SD.method: S.D.C.L. § 21-16-2: personal service by sheriff, or by leaving with adult at premises and mailing.

TN.method: Tenn. Code § 66-28-516 (URLTA): personal delivery or first-class mail.

TX.method: Tex. Prop. Code § 24.005(f), (f-1), (1) personal delivery to tenant or any person 16+ residing at premises; (2) personal delivery + affixing to INSIDE of main entry door; (3) regular, registered, or certified mail; OR (4) sealed envelope affixed to OUTSIDE of main entry door marked 'IMPORTANT DOCUMENT' + mailing same day, delivery deemed complete on affixing/mailing date.

UT.method: Utah Code § 78B-6-805: personal delivery; or substituted service with adult at premises + posting + mail.

VA.method: Va. Code § 8.01-296: personal service by sheriff or private process server; substituted service on family member at usual place of abode; posting permitted only after two attempts.

VT.method: 9 V.S.A. § 4467(g): personal delivery, certified mail with return receipt, OR first-class mail (with 3-day extension if mailed).

WA.method: RCW 59.12.040: (1) personal delivery; (2) leaving with adult at premises + mail; (3) posting in conspicuous place at premises + mail to last known address.

WI.method: Wis. Stat. § 704.21: personal delivery; if not found, substituted with competent person at premises + mail; OR posting + first-class mail.

WV.method: W. Va. Code § 55-3A-1: written notice; method must comply with magistrate court rules.

WY.method: Wyo. Stat. § 1-21-1003: personal delivery; if not feasible, substituted with adult at premises + mail.
